title: E6 Antipodal Map = Photonic Time-Reversal (BT1616-T1)

theorem.name: BT1616-T1
theorem.statement: Let phi: G_W -> E6 be the Witting embedding (BT1615). The photonic time-reversal T (BT1609) acts on Witting frames as T(f_i) = phi^{-1}(-phi(f_i)), the E6 antipodal map. Consequence: (1) 1600 frames split into 800 T-invariant pairs, (2) ancilla prep in BT1609 is the half-orbit of this Z2 pairing, (3) entropy cost of undoing T equals S_MIN = 2.0704 bits.

implications: T-reversal is not free: it costs S_MIN = 2.0704 bits of classical side-information
CPT conjugate of E6 root antipodal map = photonic phase flip on rails
800 T-pairs span all 1600 frames; no frame is T-fixed (antipodal map has no fixed points)
BT1609 ancilla prep selects one element from each T-pair: a canonical half-orbit
